Audit subtype design logic: - Msg-bearing subtypes (PAM, SERVICE, USER_LOGIN, USER_CMD) carry no direct msg-side attributes; they use the shared Audit Message entity (0..1). - Outer-field subtypes (LOGIN, SYSCALL, AVC, PROCTITLE) carry their own top-level attributes. - This avoids duplicating 12 msg fields across 4 subtypes and supports 3NF.
